reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

description.narrative: (91,740) beneficiaries received the relief aid provided in the project.

- Strengthening the ability of needy and affected families to cope with living conditions in Yemen due to the impact of disasters and emergencies. - Alleviating the suffering of families affected by natural disasters and emergencies by providing shelter materials and non-food items in Yemen. - Rapid response to emergencies and disasters during the project period

The project provides safe access for the affected and internally displaced people in emergencies and disasters in the most affected Yemeni governorates and provides aid in the form of (tents - shelter bags in addition to winter bags distributed during the winter). The aid will be secured from within the Kingdom and will be transported and stored in main warehouses to cover the existing stock. Several directorates are located within the geographical area close to this governorate, so that the response is faster and access is easier.
